run_test_single_indexing: run the unittest that tests single element indexing on a numpy array with positive and negative indices
run_test_slice_indexing: run the unittest that tests slice-based indexing on a numpy array with start and stop values
run_test_step_slice_indexing: run the unittest that tests step slice indexing on a numpy array with a step value of 2
run_test_array_indexing: run the unittest that tests array-based indexing including boolean masks and multi-dimensional index arrays
run_test_index_slice: run the unittest that tests combined array and slice indexing on a reshaped 2D numpy array
